offers_products.reason: Main offering is education programs (degrees, bootcamps); no goods or software licences sold as main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Delivers instruction through Colorado Technical University and American InterContinental University System online and campus programs.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Students enrolling in CTU, AIU, Trident and California Southern degree programs are individual buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Tuition comes from individual students, though funded partly by federal aid; employers and government are not the main buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Students pay tuition term after term over multi-year degree programs, giving ongoing repeat enrolment revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Adult education enrolment tends to hold up or rise in downturns as people retrain; not easily cut.

big_ticket.reason: Tuition is billed per term in smaller recurring payments, though a full degree totals a lot.

people_delivered.reason: Education is delivered by faculty and staff instruction, like the education example; technology platforms support it.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual students, not large enterprises or agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly online programs with only three ground campuses; growth needs little heavy plant investment.

notes: Organization buyers and big-ticket answers rest on typical for-profit education practice, not the website text.
